All 14 queries ran and gave sensible answers. I didn't check every one against the data by hand.

- **Keys:** R6 and R12 take map keys, which `qlang` treats as keywords. R6 prints its package names as strings in JSON. R12's service names went through the same route, and I didn't separately look at how the keyword in `name` is encoded.
- **Rounding:** R8's `round` has no digits argument, so it rounds to the nearest integer.
- **Map building:** R11 builds its map with `tag ::map`, which turns a vector of `[key value]` pairs into a map.

R1: filter ~(allOf /active (at :address | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin")) | sort ~(/name) * /name
R2: filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) * (* (at :items | coalesce []) | flat | * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
R6: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * (filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | sort) | flat | distinct | sort
R7: lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort
R8: lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") * (/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round
R9: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | /3) | * (split ";") | flat | filter ~(ne "") * lower | distinct | sort
R11: lines | * trim | filter ~(allOf (ne "") (startsWith "#" | not)) | * (split "=") | * ([(/0 | trim) (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)]) | filter ~(/0 | startsWith "DB_") | * ([(/0 | drop 3 | lower | keyword) /1]) | tag ::map
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) | * {:name /0 :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~(/name)
R13: {:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (at :meta | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] | * lower | groupBy ~(/) | vals | filter ~(count | gt 1) * first | sort
